need: local cache of task outputs: look up before executing, store after success
version: gradle/gradle master c2c0eb5a5250 (also in hsoliwal/gradle beabedc9cc4a)
contract_fit_evidence: DirectoryBuildCacheService.load(key, reader) and store(key, writer) work over a PersistentCache with a temporary file per key; the code needs Gradle internals (PersistentCache, FileAccessTracker, HashCode, the tar entry packer), while this plugin has no dependencies (scripts/verify.sh compiles it with javac alone) and its outputs are paths declared in m3-build.tsv, not Gradle property snapshots
decision: design adapted in BuildCache (look up before executing, store after success, temporary file then atomic move, one entry per key); no Gradle code copied

need: cache key over declared inputs that is the same in every checkout
contract_fit_evidence: SHA-256 over the task definition and the bytes of the declared inputs, folders file by file under project-relative names, no timestamps; the same sources give the same stamp in another checkout
decision: used: the key is the stamp plus the entry format version, os.name and os.arch

contract_fit_evidence: caches the results of Maven modules and their mojo executions as a core extension; polyglot targets are external processes declared in m3-build.tsv, not mojo executions, and using it would add a core extension and dependencies to a dependency-free plugin
decision: not imported; it can run next to this plugin for the Java modules of the same reactor
